prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: isolated transparent fallback visual for a premium architectural terrace homepage, not a webpage. Create one hyperrealistic orthographic architectural exploded construction rendering of a rectangular timber terrace, proportions 4m long by 2.5m deep. View from front left above, deck long edges run from lower left to upper right, front edge from left foreground toward right. The deck dominates and occupies nearly the whole landscape frame. Clearly separated aligned horizontal layers: top warm brown natural wood planks with realistic grain and small gaps; underneath exposed perpendicular timber joists; below silver aluminum transverse framing and black open extrusion support rails, one rail extending to left; beneath 15 detailed black adjustable cylindrical terrace pedestals with flanged square feet; finally thick rectangular raw grey concrete slab. All layers structurally aligned, modest vertical separation, precise credible engineering and contact shadows on the concrete, cinematic photoreal materials, soft daylight from upper left. Realistic product render with no schematic cartoons. Entire model visible with only 4% transparent padding. No text, no dimension lines, no plants, no people, no backdrop, no logos, no watermark. Genuine alpha transparency, not a checkerboard printed in the image.

Trees and forest hillside on left, late-afternoon warm light and natural subtle shadows. House has flat overhanging roof, clean sober architecture, no swimming pool, no human figures. Composition panoramic landscape about 2:1, wood terrace foreground, house right, sunlit green trees left, photographic realistic details and grain. Match refined European architectural terrace photography. No text, no logo, no claims, no watermark, no webpage content.
